categories: 社交媒体帖子,摄影,油画,复古 / 怀旧,群像 / 情侣,肖像 / 自拍
prompt_en: Create a vertical 3:4 cinematic fine-art wedding portrait of an elegant couple in a vintage studio garden setting. The groom is an East Asian young adult man with short black textured hair, wearing a classic black tuxedo jacket, white dress shirt, cream waistcoat, and black bow tie; he stands on the left, angled slightly toward the bride, his left arm wrapped around her waist and his right hand relaxed by his side. The bride is an East Asian young adult woman standing on the right with her back mostly to the camera, turned slightly toward the groom in an intimate pose; she wears an ivory satin bridal gown with a deep V-shaped open back, full structured skirt, a vertical row of covered buttons down the back, long black opera gloves, a layered pearl necklace, pearl drop earrings, and a cream pillbox-style bridal hat with a dotted birdcage veil over dark updo hair. Their faces should be close together as if about to kiss, with the mood romantic, composed, and editorial. Use a dark painterly forest-and-garden backdrop with tall shadowy trees, warm sepia-brown haze, a stone planter with pale flowers on the left, and subtle vintage garden architecture in the distance. Lighting should be soft, warm, and directional, with gentle highlights on satin fabric and pearls, muted shadows, shallow depth of field, film-grain texture, and a luxurious old-Hollywood bridal magazine aesthetic. No text, no watermark, no extra people, keep the composition waist-up to full-skirt crop with the bride’s gown occupying the lower right foreground.\

prompt_en: Create a soft, sunlit mirror-selfie fashion portrait of a young woman named the girl next door standing in a cozy bedroom covered with anime posters. She has long, slightly messy black hair and a slim build, holding a silver smartphone in front of her face so the face is mostly hidden by the phone and a soft rectangular privacy blur. She wears a cropped anime-face graphic T-shirt, a low-waisted black-and-gray plaid micro pleated skirt, and white thigh-high socks. Use warm late-afternoon sunlight entering from the left, creating strong rectangular highlights, deep soft shadows, and a distinct shadow of her body on the wall to the right. The background is an off-white wall and door corner with exactly 9 visible anime wall decorations: 1 large poster on the far left edge, 1 smaller vertical poster below it, 1 small dark poster near the doorframe, 1 large red-and-white poster above her head, 1 dark action poster behind her head, 1 pink poster at the upper right, 1 newspaper-style manga print at mid-right, 1 large blue soccer-anime poster at lower right, and 1 partially visible colorful poster at lower left. Add elegant editorial text overlay in the upper left reading LOVED SOFTLY in large cream serif capitals, with a small hand-drawn heart and the cursive line you look like home beneath it. Add a tiny poetic caption in the lower left reading the way you exist changes everything you're not just in the story you are the story, plus a small heart below. Overall style: realistic gpt-image-2 photorealism with gentle feminine mood, nostalgic bedroom aesthetic, natural skin texture, no plastic beauty retouching, soft grain, muted warm colors, vertical 3:4 composition, intimate snapshot framing, not overly glamorous.\

prompt_en: Create a luminous high-resolution anime-style illustration of a young woman standing on an outdoor café terrace on a beautiful fresh-green afternoon, viewed from a high overhead three-quarter angle. She wears a soft cream blouse with delicate ruffles, a pale yellow flowing coat or cardigan blown strongly to the right by the wind, a translucent olive-green layered skirt with floral patterns, gold strappy heeled sandals, and a small ivory chain-strap handbag. Her long light olive-blonde hair streams to the right and gradually dissolves into green halftone tone ribbons, decorated with a small cluster of white flowers and a pale bow near one ear; place a flat beige rectangular censor-like block over the center of her face. The terrace is paved with square gray stone tiles covered in intricate dappled sunlight and leaf shadows, with warm golden light, floating green leaves, and soft bokeh foliage framing the foreground. Include exactly 2 small round white café tables, exactly 3 metal café chairs, exactly 1 cream awning printed with VERDE TERRACE, and exactly 1 black chalkboard menu sign reading Verde Terrace May Special with exactly 5 menu items: Lemon \u0026 Herb Soda, Green Salad, Lemon Tart, Herbal Tea, and a small decorative botanical drawing. Add potted greenery, white daisies in a wooden planter, a cup of coffee on the left table, and a glass on the right table. Use delicate linework, transparent fabrics, yellow-green color grading, manga halftone textures blended into the wind and foliage, dreamy soft focus, and an elegant seasonal café atmosphere.\
